On contrary to what other users mentioned, the scissors opens and closes easily. The finger loops are also perfect for me (I am a male and my fingers isnt that thin). I really do not understand the other customers who wrote some good reviews on this product. I just compared some and ended up with this one just because of its good stars. I do not what it just happened, it sticks all the time. Worst scissor that I have ever seen.
The scissor blades fitted together too tightly. When in use the blades rub together and it is difficult to open and close them.

I love the feel of these scissors. It is easy for me to cut my own hair since its long and just needs a trim with no styling. These scissors have a very nice feel, easy to control, and is quite sharp. Im not a professional hair stylist so I don't have much to compare it to except the pervious pair I'd been using, but I do know that these scissors are nice and make cutting my own hair easy.  It's worth it for me to buy a nice pair of shears and do my own hair than pay someone else over $30 to do

I have been cutting my family's hair for about thirty years so I am not a professional but I do know what works. My first impression is that they feel a little cheap and they are stiff to operate. They also have a bur on the tip of the blade that I will need to file off. I quickly went to try them out on what I know to be a real test, cutting fine threads and tiny silk ribbon. Just did not feel like returning. Will use for paper. I feel like there was a big mistake somewhere. Please , just check your product. Lou
These are very nice hair scissors and the seller was very caring and considerate for checking to see if I was happy with my order.
The shears are incredibly dull.  They are  not sharp enough to cut hair at all.

reviews.t: These are Ok, but not high quality hair cutting shears.
reviews.x: These scissors are ok. If you are a hair stylist and you are used to using a very high quality scissor then these are not the ones that you would want to purchase. They are not as sharp as I would have liked for them to be. I normally cut my own bangs and my sons hair and they will work fine for my bangs but to get a sharp clean cut I would not use them all over my son's head. They are not extremely pointy either so they will not poke you in the head or ear if you are using them for cutting hair

I received these scissors as a freebie , so I could review them in detail. I used the scissors during the day to do different tasks, and my conclusion in that they are okay. While they are very sharp, they are packaged very cheaply and don't look as nice as the pair does online. Mine didn't even have a gold color to them at the bottom. reviews.t: Scissors arrived bent -- no acknowledgement from seller.
reviews.x: These scissors arrived with bent blades such that the blades scraped against each other with each cut.  Needless to say, they made a very poor cut.  I returned them for my money back and, in the process, emailed Utopia Care to tell them about my experience with their product.  The good news is that I was fully refunded by Amazon.  The bad news is that I received no acknowledgement from Utopia Care, which leads me to believe that they likely won't stand behind their product or service should othe

reviews.t: For the cost, and intended purpose, a good deal
reviews.x: This item was cheap, and for what I intended it for, I am satisfied. I have a 2-year old who has somewhat fine hair, and I was looking for a cheap pair of hair shears that would work better than regular scissors. These fit the bill. They are not perfect -- they could be sharper, but I haven't actually tried sharpening them at all yet. They fit my hands well. I'd say I have average-sized fingers. I'd recommend if you aren't expecting too much out of these.

It didn't cut hair the way I think it should. It would cut just a very small amount then just push the hair to the side.  I'm not sure if it was dull or what, but it didn't cut as well as my 20+ yr old scissors.  Very disappointed!  Of course, I threw away the packing so I can't even return them.  Live and learn, that's for sure.

reviews.t: Not as pictured but nice scissors
reviews.x: This pair of scissors is stainless steel throughout. The handles are not gold as pictured and described. The scissors have a nice feel and are lightweight, very sharp and easy to handle. I use these to hand cut my Westie ( dog) and they do a beautiful job!  I received a discount on this product for a fair and objective review.

I wasn't expecting much (I mean, look at the price) but I was still disappointed. The other reviews made me think they could at least cut hair, which was all I needed it for, but the blades were so warped I could see the space between them. Additionally, the packaging was full of misspellings, which did not impress me at all.

reviews.t: Good price for a nice, sharp hair cutting scissor.
reviews.x: I bought these scissors in three sizes mainly because the price was very reasonable.  I was pleasantly surprised when I received them that they worked easily when cutting my Yorkie's hair.  I would always have a hard time with scissors that did not cut the hair cleanly, but these certainly made it a snap.

I have really fragile hair and with the wind in the winter months my split-ends and flyaways are outrageous. I bought these scissors to help save money and to extend the time between when I needed to go get my haircut. So far they've been great! They are exactly what I need, and the price is unbeatable.

I've had these for a few years now and they're still sharp, still work great, and the size of them make it easy to maneuver when I'm trimming my dogs fur (which is the only reason I bought these.) Would definitely buy again, though I feel these wont need replacing any time soon.

I bought these for my daughter so that she can stop losing my shears.  However, once I opened the packaged, I decided to keep them for myself and give her the older ones.  These are sharp and the cutting is crisp, so far. No complaints. Scissors perform as expected.

reviews.t: Save your time and money and buy better scissors
reviews.x: These are poor quality.  They came with a chip on the blade and the packaging was really dirty.  I bought them to cut a 6 month old's hair and they took several snips to cut hair.  Don't waste your money thinking you will be getting a bargain for the price.

reviews.t: These are awesome scissors! They are nice an light weight for ...
reviews.x: These are awesome scissors! They are nice an light weight for when your holding them for long periods of time. They seem very durable which is nice in case of dropping them on the floor. They come extremely sharp for any kind of haircut your giving.

We've only used the scissors once, we bought them to trim our daughters' bangs and have used them once.  They're the sharpest thing we have in our house probably and did a nice job on the basics which is what we need them for.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the scissors sharp and effective for cutting hair, describing them as easy to use and control.
A common complaint is that the scissors are stiff, tight, or hard to open and close, with some saying they stick or rub together.
Several reviewers report the blades are dull or not sharp enough to cut hair properly.
Some reviewers consider the scissors good value for the price, though a few note they feel cheap or are not high quality.
A few reviewers mention quality issues such as misaligned or bent blades causing poor cuts.
